devdoc.details: The EVM2EVMOnRamp, CommitStore and EVM2EVMOffRamp form an xchain upgradeable unit. Any change to one of them results an onchain upgrade of all 3.OCR2BaseNoChecks is used to save gas, signatures are not required as the offramp can only execute messages which are committed in the commitStore. We still make use of OCR2 as an executor whitelist and turn-taking mechanism.

ConfigSet((address,uint64,uint64,address.details: Atlas depends on this event, if changing, please notify Atlas.

params.configCount: ordinal number of this config setting among all config settings over the life of this contract
params.f: maximum number of faulty/dishonest oracles the protocol can tolerate while still working correctly
params.offchainConfig: serialized configuration used by the oracles exclusively and only passed through the contract
params.offchainConfigVersion: version of the serialization format used for "offchainConfig" parameter

params.previousConfigBlockNumber: block in which the previous config was set, to simplify historic analysis
params.signers: ith element is address ith oracle uses to sign a report

ExecutionStateChanged(uint64,bytes32,uin.details: RMN depends on this event, if changing, please notify the RMN maintainers.

executeSingleMessage((uint64,address,add.details: We make this external and callable by the contract itself, in order to try/catch its execution and enforce atomicity among successful message processing and token transfer.We use ERC-165 to check for the ccipReceive interface to permit sending tokens to contracts (for example smart contract wallets) without an associated message.

params.message: The message that will be executed.
params.offchainTokenData: Token transfer data to be passed to TokenPool.

getAllRateLimitTokens().details: the order of IDs in the list is **not guaranteed**, therefore, if ordering matters when making successive calls, one should keep the block height constant to ensure a consistent result.

returns.destTokens: The destination representation of the tokens that are rate limited.
returns.sourceTokens: The source representation of the tokens that are rate limited.

getExecutionState(uint64).details: we use the literal number 128 because using a constant increased gas usage.

params.sequenceNumber: The sequence number of the message to get the execution state for.

returns._0: The current execution state of the message.

returns.nonce: The nonce value belonging to the sender address.

getStaticConfig().details: This function will always return the same struct as the contents is static and can never change. RMN depends on this function, if changing, please notify the RMN maintainers.

getTransmitters().details: The list will match the order used to specify the transmitter during setConfig

returns._0: list of addresses permitted to transmit reports to this contract

returns.blockNumber: block at which this config was set
returns.configCount: ordinal number of current config, out of all configs applied to this contract so far

returns.scanLogs: indicates whether to rely on the configDigest and epoch returned or whether to scan logs for the Transmitted event instead.

manuallyExecute(((uint64,address,address.details: We permit gas limit overrides so that users may manually execute messages which failed due to insufficient gas provided.

params.gasLimitOverrides: New gasLimit for each message in the report.

setAdmin(address).details: setting this to address(0) indicates there is no active admin.

params.newAdmin: the address of the new admin.

params.f: number of faulty oracles the system can tolerate
params.signers: addresses with which oracles sign the reports
params.transmitters: addresses oracles use to transmit the reports

setRateLimiterConfig((bool,uint128,uint1.details: should only be callable by the owner or token limit admin.

params.report: serialized report, which the signatures are signing.
params.rs: ith element is the R components of the ith signature on report. Must have at most MAX_NUM_ORACLES entries
params.ss: ith element is the S components of the ith signature on report. Must have at most MAX_NUM_ORACLES entries

params.adds: - A list of one or more tokens to be added.
params.removes: - A list of one or more tokens to be removed.

i_commitStore.details: Commit store address on the destination chain

i_metadataHash.details: metadataHash is a lane-specific prefix for a message hash preimage which ensures global uniqueness. Ensures that 2 identical messages sent to 2 different lanes will have a distinct hash. Must match the metadataHash used in computing leaf hashes offchain for the root committed in the commitStore and i_metadataHash in the onRamp.

i_onRamp.details: OnRamp address on the source chain

i_prevOffRamp.details: The address of previous-version OffRamp for this lane. Used to be able to provide sequencing continuity during a zero downtime upgrade.

i_rmnProxy.details: The address of the RMN proxy

i_tokenAdminRegistry.details: The address of the token admin registry

s_executionStates.details: A mapping of sequence numbers to execution state using a bitmap with each execution state only taking up 2 bits of the uint256, packing 128 states into a single slot. Message state is tracked to ensure message can only be executed successfully once.

s_rateLimitedTokensDestToSource.details: Tokens that should be included in Aggregate Rate Limiting An (address => address) map is used for backwards compatability of offchain code

s_senderNonce.details: The expected nonce for a given sender. Corresponds to s_senderNonce in the OnRamp, used to enforce that messages are executed in the same order they are sent (assuming they are DON). Note that re-execution of FAILED messages however, can be out of order.

userdoc.notice: EVM2EVMOffRamp enables OCR networks to execute multiple messages in an OffRamp in a single transaction.
